description: Image Description: A vintage steam locomotive, painted in a striking red and black color scheme with gold detailing, is traveling along a set of railway tracks through a lush, green countryside. The train emits a thick plume of white steam from its chimney, which billows upward into the clear blue sky dotted with fluffy white clouds. The locomotive pulls a series of dark-colored passenger carriages behind it, suggesting a heritage or tourist rail service. The surrounding landscape features well-maintained grassy areas
